verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting product that also ships a CLI and MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The security docs cover only encryption, Plaid connectivity and role-based access, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
